verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's own UI includes only a narrow built-in AI feature: a 'Describe your search' panel that turns natural language into a BadgerQL search query, not a general-purpose assistant you can delegate broader tasks to. Its MCP server (docs-13/14) lets external AI agents control Honeybadger, but that's an external agent using Honeybadger as a tool, not an assistant built into the product itself. Missing for 10: a genuine in-app assistant capable of multi-step task delegation (e.g., resolving errors, running investigations, setting alarms) beyond search-query generation, and any independent/hands-on validation of this search-assist feature.
